EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerEnableTickProfile
EnumProperty.Description: Shared by Common and the client, for every configuration. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerBetaLabel
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: draws the 'Beta 2' label in the top-left corner of every frame (FREELANCER_BETA_LABEL, client only). After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerWidescreenSupport
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: display modes wider than 4:3 in the options, Hor+ cameras and HUD windows at the screen edges (FREELANCER_WIDESCREEN_SUPPORT, client only). Off builds the retail 4:3-only behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerRp9
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: builds RP9.dll (the Direct3D 9 mirror of RP8, needs the DirectX SDK June 2010) and the client's Direct3D 9 extension hooks such as the volumetric nebula (FREELANCER_RP9). Select it at run time with DirectX9 in bin\DACOM.INI. Off builds neither. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerWalkMode
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game: walking through base rooms as Trent (FREELANCER_WALK_MODE, client only; docs/walk_mode.md). Off builds the retail base screens. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerHudTargetView
EnumProperty.DisplayName: Target HUD: target view with the contact list
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (the HudTarget.dll plugin): the expanded target panel shows the target view and its details in every mode, without the 'Switch to target' button (FREELANCER_HUD_TARGET_VIEW, client only; docs/hud_plugins.md). Off builds the retail panel. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerHudStatusView
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (the HudStatus.dll plugin): the expanded status panel draws the player's ship with its damage colours, like the target view (FREELANCER_HUD_STATUS_VIEW, client only; docs/hud_plugins.md). Off builds the retail panel. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerHudInventoryView
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (the HudInventory.dll plugin): a toggle in the inventory swaps the item list for the ship with its equipment and free hardpoints, which can be picked and mounted on; ship views frame the hull to fill the preview; per-ship framing in DATA\INTERFACE\HudInventory.ini (FREELANCER_HUD_INVENTORY_VIEW, client only; docs/hud_plugins.md). Off builds the retail inventory. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerDbgOptions
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (the 2002 beta's DBG_OPTIONS window): Ctrl+Shift+O opens the debug option table, and its [OUTLINES] entries draw collision hulls, physical spheres, shields and phantoms in space (FREELANCER_DBG_OPTIONS, client and Common.dll; docs/dbg_options.md). Off builds the retail behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerFlsharp
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (BC46's FLSharp.dll): bug fixes and improvements of the client and server, ported one by one (FREELANCER_FLSHARP, client, Common.dll and Server.dll; docs/flsharp.md). Off builds the retail behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerFlplusplus
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (TheStarport's flplusplus.dll): settings in flplusplus.ini next to freelancer.exe (LOD / render distance, pbubble and character detail scales, save and screenshot folders, ship preview zoom), private fonts from DATA\FONTS\fonts.ini [FontFiles], PNG screenshots, FLSpew timestamps, mouse wheel scrolling of lists and texts (FREELANCER_FLPLUSPLUS, client and Common.dll; docs/flplusplus.md). Off builds the retail behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: FreelancerJflp
EnumProperty.Description: Not in the original game (Jason Hood's jflp.dll): stats for powerplants, engines, scanners, tractor beams and armor; sector letter first; Alt+Enter toggles windowed mode; roll in mouse flight; 8-way strafe; server info of other versions; the first weapon group active in space (FREELANCER_JFLP, client and Common.dll; docs/jflp.md). Off builds the retail behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.
